messages.subject: inla predict
parts:
Hello 

I want predict months in 2023, as below code, but inla.predict is not available 

# predict quantiles and fill columns with predicted values
for (i in 1:nrow(datam)) {
  pred <- inla.predict(result, newdata = datam[i,], type = "quantile",
                  ci = TRUE, interval = "prediction")
  quantiles <- as.data.frame(t(pred$quantiles))
  names(quantiles) <- paste0("q", c(0.01, 0.025, seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05), 0.975, 0.99)*100)
  df[i, names(quantiles)] <- quantiles
}

what is your suggestion?

thanks
Aynaz
